items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: he was a teacher for most of the musicians... I went to him myself

ctx.x: You know where they learned, who their teacher was or anything?

No I couldn't answer on that. But I know that… That Shara Nees… Oh yeah. You see he was a teacher for most of the musicians. You see? Yeah I've heard a lot about him. Yeah. Now I don't know if he… he… he… he… teach those or not, but he was well known. All the musicians went to him, because I went to him myself. Yeah. Yeah. I went to him myself too. Oh you did. But I didn't keep up, but he tell me, oh that's pico too. I went to pico. Oh yeah, you did. Yeah I went to pico, but all the trouble, if you keep up you'll…
Did George Bakke help people? Did he ever give any regular lessons or help the young fellas?
